description: DISCLOSED v1 APPROXIMATION (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md 7.5). s.194J's 50,000 limit is an ANNUAL AGGREGATE, but v1 tests it PER TRANSACTION. A deductor paying the same professional 25,000 twice in a year crosses the annual limit and must deduct 10% on the aggregate from the second payment onwards; v1 sees 25,000 < 50,000 on BOTH and derives NIL. This fixture pins the v1 behaviour (basis ANNUAL is recorded in the result so the approximation is machine-visible) — it is NOT a claim that NIL is the statutorily correct answer for the second payment.
